name: Love Like Ice
source:
Snow, as far as you can see…

Hungry owls stationed in the surrounding barren trees stare you down from their perches…

You can feel your strength bleeding out with every step forward.

You may be an experienced monster hunter, but dangerous weather can stop even the most powerful in their tracks. Beside you is Liev – a fellow hunter, and your lover. You’ve been tasked by the sleepy town of Rimewich to find and eliminate the elusive beast that has claimed many villagers’ lives. Liev, however, desires to turn back because of the blizzard.

What dangers await you in this wintry landscape? Will you stay by Liev’s side, or cut your own path? And just what is the beast that has besieged Rimewich? 

Carefully choose your words and actions. You may yet save not only yourself…
